negativeConstraints: Never invent any text, logo, wordmark or mark beyond the ones this record names, never misspell or rearrange those, and never add a second label. Never add a date window, a bezel scale or a second subdial.
preservationNotes: Keep the dial exactly: warm sand with a slightly darker outer sector ring, bold black Arabic numerals at 12, 3, 6 and 9, black baton markers at the other hours, a black railway minute track, ALDERGATE in small black spaced capitals below 12 and AUTOMATIC in smaller capitals above 6. Keep the heat-blued sword hands and thin blued seconds hand, the brushed steel case with polished bevels, and the tan suede strap with cream stitching in every shot.
